data.name: Ihsan
data.gender_notes: Ihsan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ihsan is an Arabic term that means to do something better than is expected. In Islamic context, it refers to worshipping Allah as if one sees Him, and to remember that He is watching at all times. The name Ihsan carries the meaning “Perfection, Excellence” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ihsan usually hope their child will grow to embody perfection, excellence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ihsan is one of the three dimensions of the Islamic faith, along with Iman (faith) and Islam (submission).
data.etymology: Ihsan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Perfection, Excellence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ihsan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

This is why Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "Ihsan is to worship Allah as if you see Him." By embodying this principle, individuals contribute to excellence in their communities and societies, fostering greater progress and development.
data.spiritual_significance: The concept of Ihsan is deeply rooted in spiritual awareness and has been recognized as one of the virtues in Islamic literature. It inspires Muslims to connect with their Creator at the deepest level, with the belief that Allah is constantly present and observing their every action. This unwavering sense of His presence fuels the desire to perform good deeds and abandon all wrongdoing, ultimately transforming the individual into a better human being and drawing them closer to their Lord.
